title: Seasonal sale announcement
description: Promote a seasonal in-store and online sale such as end-of-season or holiday offers. Seasonal campaign WhatsApp template for retailers.
notes: Put the sale dates and discount range up front. Seasonal blasts do best when sent in the morning of the first day.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, our End of Season Sale starts today! Save up to *{{percent}}%* in store and online through {{date}}. Hurry, sizes go quickly.
